_comment: Exclusion plane for the projected 2050 measurement: the e-mu texture of the theory notes, (T13), with |U_e4| = |U_mu4| = 0.5 (the solver's benchmark), epsilon' = 1e-4; at each (m_Zd, g_D) nothing else floats, so every point is one evaluation of chi^2 and the excluded region is where Delta chi^2 exceeds the 2D thresholds. The plane is read per mediator mass (raster), at the 1D thresholds: excluded where Delta chi^2 from each mass's own minimum exceeds 3.84 (95%), decided 2026-10-13.
name: pion_2050_case_5_exclusion_galx

solver._comment: Physics of FrequentistAnalysis' pion_2050_case_5 configurations, except the mixing: there it was fixed at the solver's defaults (delta_CP = 132 deg, sin^2 theta_23 = 0.571, ...), 0.0034 in f_mu (0.7 sigma) away from the projection's centre, which assumes NuFIT 6.0 normal ordering with SK atmospheric data. Here the mixing is that fit's (sin^2 theta_12 = 0.308, sin^2 theta_13 = 0.02215, sin^2 theta_23 = 0.470, delta_CP = 212 deg, Delta m^2_21 = 7.49e-5, Delta m^2_31 = 2.513e-3 eV^2), which reproduces the centre to 1e-6. Grid: 400 energy bins and 200 redshift steps (energy-averaged fractions within 1.5e-5 of 1000 x 1000 at inband, 2e-4 at m_Zd = 1e-2 eV; 2026-10-12, corrected solver); 12 Earth chords (within 1.4e-7 of 50); the transit to the Earth (dp_transit, 2026-10-13) with 8 directions to the Sun and frame-table spacing 0.002 (chi2 within 0.03 of 32 directions and 0.001 at the potential planes' critical points).

_comment_galactic: With the Galactic component (tools/make_galactic_configs.py; Mauricio, 2026-10-14): CRINGE x norm_gal (Gaussian 0.91 +- 0.18, IceCube 2026), dark-portal emission points in 3-D; the data are the flavor surface and IceCube 2026's astrophysical spectrum (10 TeV - 1 PeV) against the extragalactic flux at the Earth; the extragalactic normalization (norm_astro, no prior) and spectral index (p_index) float. Source compositions free: extragalactic (f_e_S, 1 - f_e_S, 0) and Galactic (f_e_S_gal, 1 - f_e_S_gal, 0), independently.
